notes.title: Patch notes for February 3, 2022
notes.content:
This minor update addresses the issue of broken or missing save game files. 

As some in the Discussions have reported, they cannot proceed when their save game file is missing. This update now adds more descriptive warnings to that missing file prompt along with a "REBUILD" button to reconstruct game progress from server records [i]TO BE USED AS A LAST RESORT![/i]

Steps to take if you encounter game save loading issues (either "File missing" or "errorcode 3" error prompt):

[b]ERRORCODE 3:[/b]
NOTE: Tampering with save files can [i]CAUSE [/i]errors and we are not responsible for lost progress, data, or purchases.

1. Locate your save game folder in Windows. It will be somewhere like this:
C:\Users\[b][YOUR WINDOWS USER NAME][/b]\AppData\LocalLow\Evil Twin\Gentlemen's Club\Saves\[b][YOUR STEAM ID #][/b]

2. If you are not a new player, the folder will contain several '[i]savegame.XXX[/i]' files where the file extension will be either "PNG" or numbers instead of the XXX in this example. Rename [b]savegame.png[/b] to something else

3. Identify which of the remaining backup saves is the most recent. It will usually be the file with the biggest number as the file extension. 

eg: [b]savegame.123[/b] is more recent than [b]savegame.004[/b]

Rename that file to[b] savegame.png[/b]

4. Now run [i]Gentlemen's Club[/i] again and cross your fingers. XD

5. If that didn't work, try the next most recent backup save file.

6. If none of those work, rename [b]savegame.png[/b] to something like [b]_savegame.png[/b] and run the game, which will lead to the next error:


[b]MISSING SAVE FILE![/b]

If your save file is missing (either "accidentally" or through the previous section's trouble shooting) the game will halt and complain that the file is missing. 

1. If you were screwing around with the file, spank yourself, put it back, and then hit RETRY.

2. There is no reason for save files to go missing with normal use of the game. But if somehow this happened to you, look for backup save files and follow the tips in the section above.

3. If none of the above works, the last resort is to rebuild your game save from our server's records: Hit the REBUILD button. Some game progress may be lost.
